# Profile README setup

Most of `README.md` renders live and needs nothing. Two pieces are generated by
GitHub Actions and need a one-time setup.

## 1. 3D contribution graph — works out of the box

`.github/workflows/profile-3d-contrib.yml` runs daily and commits SVGs to
`profile-3d-contrib/`. It only uses the built-in `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

Run it once manually (**Actions → 3D Contribution Graph → Run workflow**) so the
images exist — until then those two `<img>` tags in the Stats section are broken.

Requires **Settings → Actions → General → Workflow permissions → Read and write**.

## 2. Coding Habits block — needs a PAT

`.github/workflows/waka-readme-stats.yml` fills in everything between the
`<!--START_SECTION:waka-->` / `<!--END_SECTION:waka-->` markers (commit-hour
breakdown, day-of-week breakdown, language-per-repo, lines-of-code chart).

1. Create a classic PAT with `repo` and `read:user` scopes.
2. Add it as repo secret **`GH_TOKEN`**.
3. Run the workflow manually once.

### Optional: WakaTime blocks

For the "This Week I Spent My Time On" section (editors, OS, per-project time),
sign up at [wakatime.com](https://wakatime.com), install the editor plugin, add
your API key as secret **`WAKATIME_API_KEY`**, and flip the `SHOW_TOTAL_CODE_TIME`,
`SHOW_TIMEZONE`, `SHOW_LANGUAGE`, `SHOW_EDITORS`, `SHOW_PROJECTS`, and `SHOW_OS`
inputs to `"True"`.

## Notes

- Stats/top-langs cards point at the `github-readme-stats-sigma-five.vercel.app`
  mirror. The official `github-readme-stats.vercel.app` instance is frequently
  rate-limited (HTTP 503), which renders as a broken image.
- Streak stats and the activity graph use `<picture>` with
  `prefers-color-scheme`, so they follow the viewer's GitHub theme. The 3D graph
  uses the `#gh-light-mode-only` / `#gh-dark-mode-only` trick instead.
- Accent colour throughout is `#00B3B3`.
